opening.argument: The video is presented in the setting of the HAC 2016 Rural Housing Conference, with the title identifying Colleen Briggs and JPMorgan Chase in a rural-building context. The discussion concerns corporate philanthropy, economic opportunity, and affordable housing, including a stated effort to expand access to vital opportunities: "a five-year $125 million program that's focused on how do we increase the availability and the accessibility of vital economic opportunities such as affordable housing." It further describes using local knowledge so overlooked communities can access safe, affordable housing. Nothing in the described material presents a consumer transaction offer, requests money or credentials, or promotes an investment scheme; it is a conference discussion of housing and economic opportunity.
